title: Convert a UK societas to a public limited company (SE CV01)
text:
You can use this form to convert an existing UK societas ( UKS ) to a PLC.

 It costs £124. Make your cheque or postal order payable to Companies House.

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
